scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.js && git add launcher/InsertechLauncher.csproj app.manifest android/app/build.gradle
scripts.build:exe: npm run build && dotnet publish launcher -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:PublishTrimmed=true -o ./dist-win && node scripts/copy-artifact.js win
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && dotnet publish launcher -c Release -r linux-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:PublishTrimmed=true -o ./dist-linux && node scripts/copy-artifact.js linux
scripts.build:all: npm run build:exe && npm run build:linux && npm run build:mobile
